provenance: De-identified summaries from an existing local staff chart. Scores are source-author claims. Skill labels and task contexts are illustrative classifications, not new observations.

examples.comment: Independent checks identified evidence and contract inconsistencies.
examples.example: A comparison exposed an ambiguous label mapping before acceptance.
examples.guidance: Consider evidence verification and technical review work; measure cost on the next actual task.

examples.comment: Local summaries report useful diagnosis and independent review work.
examples.example: A separator comparison explained why a measurement produced an unexpected result.
examples.guidance: Consider diagnosis and reverse-engineering investigations, with independent result checks.

examples.comment: The source chart has no measured capability scores for this model.
examples.example: No completed capability observation was available in the source summary.
examples.guidance: Collect a small bounded task observation before proposing a skill fit.

examples.comment: Local summaries report reliable structured extraction and contract work.
examples.example: A structured technical document was produced while unresolved questions were preserved.
examples.guidance: Consider bounded routine work and review assistance; verify complex diagnosis separately.

examples.comment: Local summaries report consistent short supervision tasks.
examples.example: A count inconsistency was noticed during a routine status check.
examples.guidance: Consider short evidence checks and bounded monitoring tasks; record actual cost and elapsed work time.

examples.comment: Local summaries report implementation after correction cycles.
examples.example: A multi-file change needed compilation corrections before the checks completed.
examples.guidance: Consider scoped implementation with a clear contract and review support.

examples.comment: Historical summaries report scoped implementation, review, and diagnosis work.
examples.example: A bounded implementation passed its specified checks while incomplete runs remained recorded.
examples.guidance: Consider bounded implementation and technical review work, with explicit tool constraints and independent checks.

examples.comment: The source chart has no scored local work for this model.
examples.example: The model was an unused candidate in the historical reference.
examples.guidance: Start with a small, inexpensive observation before assigning a specialized task.
